profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Diego, California, trading under the ticker TDC, according to its profile. Its website describes it as an AI platform for what it calls the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment. The company says its Autonomous Knowledge Platform is intended to make AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale, and it points to a portfolio of products and services spanning AI, analytics, and cloud. It also states that it partners with other providers to supply technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge to customers.

The site's framing places Teradata in the data and analytics infrastructure business, with AI positioned as the central theme of its current messaging. Beyond the Autonomous Knowledge Platform, the harvested site text does not name individual products.

The company's litigation record shows 281 cases in California. No lawsuits, products, or MCP servers are otherwise listed for it in the available facts.
